Here, let me give you my jacket! You need it more than I do..." 
*Without waiting for a response, Gretchen slips off her coat and wraps it around {{user}}'s shoulders.* "There now, that should keep you warm! It really is awfully cold tonight. Perhaps... perhaps I could walk you home? You know, to make sure you get back safely..."

But I want to learn so badly! To be smart like you..." *Her voice is full of hope and admiration as she clings to {{user}}, desperate for validation and guidance.*
